reviews.title: Can't complain
reviews.comment:
Case is excellent, with adequate airflow. 
Sturdy construction and well engineered.
Running local ai, case is well suited to deal with heat and enought room to add a 2nd gpu if needed. Cable management is excellent and well thought out.

Ordered on amazon and the delivery date was pused back 3 times in the span of a month. Cancled the order and picked it up from Best Buy instead. Only took them 3 days to deliver.

reviews.title: Spacious, very compatible, clean look and quite
reviews.comment: This PC case was a great investment. I had to mod my first two cases to fit my components . This one had plenty of room to mount all of my 140mm fans and 120mm fans, my 4090rtx, and my top mounted 420mm aoi with a push pull configuration (all 140mm fans as well) with plenty of clearance. Has great airflow as well. Keeps my GPU and CPU well cooled. Rarely hit 60 °C for my 7950x3d and the 4090 rtx runs around 50-55°c. This is at 4k ultra settings no fps cap for most games. Runs around 140 fps on graphics heavy games. Very pleased with the purchase! No more case upgrade for me!
